topic: Session content stored before SP-023 whose transcript is gone is quarantined
detail: The relabel places a session record or transcript stored without an origin by the session's pin only when the record names a transcript that is that session's own, where its harness keeps it (the check live writes get, against planted hand-off entries). Claude Code deletes old transcripts, so older sessions' records and transcripts go to quarantine. Option: trust the pin alone for writer=session chunks stored before SP-023 (the writer field is orchd's own, but pre-SP-023 hand-offs did not check transcript locations). Recommendation: keep quarantine; the operator retags what is wanted (SP-071).
